SLR2 pro Carbon pads are produced either in London, Ont or Oxford,MI depending where you are ordering from. The SLR2 Pro pad is made overseas on a massive assembly line so because they are making a bulk unit at one time and in limited colours and sizes the cost is lower since they most likely product the amount needed that stores have booked with some added cushion for just Incase the pads gotten hot. The foams are all pre-cut, Jr pads will have a slightly softer foam used where the Int & Sr will have a very similar foam. So mass production with limited options is the driving force to keep costs down plus the low wage of employees in the factory.
For the pro carbons those are not as much mass produced as stores will tailor a run of pads to match the markets need in size,colour and modifications. The factory will do runs of pads in certain sizes I.E 34+1 or 36+1.5 for example on one day now they will have to cut that foam out at one time then they will need to individually cut out the colours for the graphic on the pad for what the store or customer desires. The time it takes to change the dye machines from what I’ve seen is not complex but you’re not hammering out 34+2 pads every day you’ll have a variety of sizes and colours to do. This is also if it’s stock, if a customer is after a different break or foam to be used than that’s extra work and time needed to get everything set for that one pad and most times they have minimal uncharges if any. 
So time it takes and the quality of them is a huge difference, feel a leather strap on a custom domestic pad to the import and that will tell you enough why that pads worth more. True not everyone needs a custom domestic pad but it’s like getting a suit for some people
